sources.h1: Bad Pixel Pedals — Germanium Gold Face Fuzz
sources.excerpt:
- **Archive parent:** Germanium Gold Face Fuzz
- **Builder:** Bad Pixel Pedals
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Point-to-point germanium Fuzz Face-style fuzz using two Russian NOS GT402 germanium transistors and an external Bias control, with a gold-leaf finish. [1][2]

- **Fuzz**
- **Volume**
- **External Bias**
- True bypass.
- Positive-ground configuration. [1]

- **2 × Russian NOS GT402 germanium transistors.**
- Individual gain/leakage measurements are not published. [1]

- Exact clipping/protection diode arrangement is not documented.

Bad Pixel specifies:
- No PCB, all point-to-point.
- Push-back cloth wire.
- NOS USSR military-spec capacitors.
- 1/2-watt carbon-composition resistors.
- Alpha pots.
- Neutrik jacks.
- Handmade in Greece.
- Gold-leaf finish over the enclosure. [1][2]

- **9V battery**.
- Standard negative-tip external supply is documented.
- **Positive ground**, so the pedal is not intended for conventional daisy chaining with negative-ground pedals. [1]

- No numbered electronic revision established.
- Gold-leaf/relic patterns are individual-finish details, not circuit versions.

Bad Pixel describes the Gold Face as sustaining strongly while cleaning up from the guitar volume control. External Bias provides additional control over saturation and operating point. [1]

- **Identity:** High
- **Fuzz Face lineage:** High
- **2 × GT402:** High
- **External Bias:** High
- **Positive ground:** High
- **Point-to-point:** High
- **Exact diode:** Unknown

The builder's Gold Face page and exact Reverb listing were cross-checked. The documentation supports the GT402 pair, point-to-point construction, external Bias, positive-ground operation and gold-leaf finish. [1][2]

sources.h1: Bad Pixel Pedals — Germanium Gold Face Fuzz
sources.excerpt:
GOLD Face Germanium - Bad Pixel Pedals Fuzz Overdrive Boost CLASSIC SERIES Custom Videos artwork About Bad Pixel Pedals_Germanium Gold Face This is a luxurious Face. -all point to point wiring [no pcb]. -all USSR high quality, military specs [most] capacitors -all 1/2 watt carbon comp resistors -2x Russian [nos]  GT402 Germanium transistors -Push back cloth wire -alpha pots -neutrik jacks -Highest quality -Hand built in Greece Fantastic specimen of point to point wiring. Everything is how it is supposed to be. I like to exaggerate sometimes and this is one of those times. Gold leaf, everything of the highest quality and sonically excellent. It screams, it sustains, it cleans up really nicely. It does it all. It also features an external bias pot. Unique patterns that are taken from my family's transitional hand knit creations. It does take you back to another time. It is special and it is extravagant. It is positive ground so it cannot be daisy chained. It runs with standard negative tip power supply or 9v battery. A rare piece of electronics as there is no board  inside, all the components are soldered to one another. It is a very time consuming procedure but it makes the pedal one of a kind. Using the best materials combined with these methods of construction give you the best possible result both sonically and aesthetically. The pedal is covered with gold [not real gold] leaf [no it is not paint] in A RELIC-DISTRESSED fashion the same technique they use in byzantine icon making. It gives it a very unique look. It makes it somehow precious to the eye. Powered by Create your own unique website with customizable templates. Get Started

Guitar Pedal X - News - Best of Greek Guitar Pedals and Pedal Builders ao link News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Xploration • Curation • Recommendation News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index News GPX AI Forums Notifications Popular Highlights 4 of a Kind 12 Degrees of Saturation ArtistArray Best in Class Best of Brands Builder Profiles Colours Expo Guitar Pedal 101 Iconic Gear In Memoriam Pedal Chain Pedal Planet Trifecta Versus Index Enter a search term Search Remember Login Register | Reset Password Filter content by area of interest Amps Boost and Overdrive Delay Distortion Fuzz Guitars Modulation Pitch Reverb Utility All All Best of Greek Guitar Pedals and Pedal Builders Apr 14, 2019 20:07 by  Stefan Karlsson Bad Pixel Pedals Boost Boost and Overdrive Chorus and Vibrato Crazy Tube Circuits Distortion Dreadbox FX Drive Effects Pedal Makers Flanger Fuzz Fuzz Face Style Fuzz Fuzz-Drive and Fuzzstortion JAM Pedals Modulation Multi-Drive Overdrive Pedal Planet Rat Pedals Rat Style Fuzz Side Effects Tone Concepts Tsakalis Audio Works VS Audio + - This article continues the series which I started with Best of British , Canadian , French , German and Italian Pedal Builders - some of which could do with updating probably, but frankly I prefer doing new stuff. It turns out that Greece is actually a significant hub of activity with a number of Internationally renown brands. I feel the big 3 are Crazy Tube Circuits, JAM Pedals and Tsakalis Audioworks, while VS Audio also has had some significant publicity fairly recently and particularly in the UK - courtesy of luminaries like Rabea Massaad and Chris Buck. Of the Top 9 - pretty much all were known to me and very much a shoe-in - with only Rat Pedals needing some further consideration. In terms of ownership - I own 2 CTC pedals and 2 from Side Effects - and fully intend to acquire the JAM Rattler and Tsakalis Six at some stage this year alongside likely one or two more. While many/most would likely agree with my top brands selection here - the ’chosen’ pedals from each are obviously more a personal preference thing. My top selection consists wholly of pedals I have considered for acquisition - or am currently considering - it’s no more complicated than that. Generally too the Greek pedal-making ’industry’ seems to be in pretty good health and there are a smattering of fledgling brands doing interesting things - as we shall see. Pedal makers listed in alphabetical order - first my Top 9, then the remainder: Bad Pixel Pedals (badpixel.weebly.com) The Greeks seem to value privacy as the majority of their pedal brands don't reveal their key personas - such is the case too for Fuzz and Boost/Overdrive specialist Bad Pixel Pedals - they only make pedals within those two categories. There are currently 10 pedals in the range, and the standout for me is the germanium transistor-switching Pink Face - Fuzz Faze style pedal with top-edge-mounted control knobs and side-mounted bias dial and transistor toggle-switch (Note that above demo is of much larger original Germanium Fuzz Face which though uses very similar circuit and same transistors): Like = Bad Face Silicon | Buzzaround Fuzz | Classic Model 1 Fuzz | Classic Model 2 Fuzz | Classic Model 3 Fuzz | Fuck_Fuck Twin Tub
